name: The Awakening of the Bastion
setting: Late 19th-century gothic fantasy citadel suspended in an eternal golden autumn

sectors.narratorQuote: The youth awoke upon the vast castle grounds. The crisp air carried scents of dry autumn leaves and fresh aether...
One false step and it was over. But this kid knew how to bend gravity to his will.
Deep within the clocktower, massive iron cogs groaned, lifting the portcullis toward the clouds.
And so they stepped into a new dawn, fully armed and attuned to ancient Aether. The first trial was conquered, yet the deeper heart of the castle still slept...
The master circuit proved their mettle; the Awakened Duelists claimed dominion over the high battlements.
